name: Maria Theresia
source:
"You're not alone, if you're worried you can rely on me. We might not meet again, but I'll at least send you letters."

Born in Austria.
Hobby: Reading
Likes: [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chinoiserie]Chinoiserie[/url]
Dislikes: Inflexible People

The Austrian Arch-Duchess.
She's usually kind, but as an empress she knows to be dignified.
She's always worrying about her daughter [url=/c50768]Marie[/url] and her letters to her are always filled with scoldings.
